definitions.explanation: The major artery on each side of the neck that supplies blood to the head and brain. Its pulse is often checked in first aid to confirm that the heart is beating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{頸動脈|けいどうみゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a carotid artery in the neck.

examples.japanese: {頸動脈|けいどうみゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{脈|みゃく}→脈：05247_myaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the pulse at the carotid artery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{頸動脈|けいどうみゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れて→触れる：01984_fureru⟧⟦{脈|みゃく}がある→脈がある：20084_myakugaaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: At an emergency scene, you touch the carotid artery to check whether there is a pulse.

notes:
The large artery running up each side of the neck to the brain.
